$comment: Framework layer graph. Each module may import only the framework modules listed in dependsOn (enforced by ESLint). Change deliberately and update docs/architecture.md.

ai.description: Vendor-neutral AI client port, tool registry, agent loop, SSE streaming.

core.description: BrandConfig, module system, app kernel, FrameworkProvider and FrameworkContext.

di.description: Typed, decorator-free dependency injection container with scopes and multi-bindings.

foundation.description: Result, AppError, emitter, observable store, utilities. Zero dependencies.

i18n.description: Locale service, ICU-lite interpolation, plurals, RTL, typed translation keys.

network.description: REST, GraphQL and WebSocket clients with middleware pipeline and auth refresh.

observability.description: Logger, crash reporter, analytics and tracing ports with composable adapters.

presentation.description: MVVM view models and MVI stores bound to React via useSyncExternalStore.

state.description: Redux Toolkit store factory, dynamic reducer injection, persistence, shell slices.

storage.description: Key-value, secure storage and local database ports with adapters.

testing.description: Test harness: in-memory adapters, mock transports, renderWithFramework.

theme.description: Design tokens, light/dark schemes, brand overrides, ThemeProvider.

ui.description: Atomic design components (atoms -> templates) with brand-overridable registry.
